_comment: Real sidecars from the bids-standard/bids-examples corpus (master). The whole corpus was swept at generation time: 5853 files decoded with no exception, and the 328 that declined are headerless derivative tables (motion, timeseries, mixing, physio) and non-core derivative JSON, which this decoder is not meant to claim.

trial_phase.Description: Whether the trial was before or after the unfiltered speech, or whether it *was* the unfiltered speech

trial_num.Description: The trial to which the set of bef/mid/aft events corresponds

filt_type.Description: The type of sound filtering used to degrade the stimulus

noise_stim.Description: Whether the middle sound was noise (no linguistic context given) or unfiltered speech (full linguistic content)

fields.EEGCoordinateSystemDescription: 70 Easycap sites, roughly corresponding to extended 10-20 system: see http://imaging.mrc-cbu.cam.ac.uk/meg/VectorviewDescription#EEGlabels
fields.DigitizedHeadPointsCoordinateSystemDescr: Headpoints include arcs of points along front of head and around nose, as well as centre of 70 EEG electrodes spread across scalp, which also help define headshape. Beware that nose points can bias coregistration with MRI if MRI image does not include all of the nose.
fields.AnatomicalLandmarkCoordinateSystemDescri: For images of anatomical landmarks, see http://imaging.mrc-cbu.cam.ac.uk/meg/SubjectPreparation
